description: Return one crew: its members as full expert entries, and the install command for each integration it names. A crew composes and copies nothing, so changing a member changes the crew. Its README says what it is for and where it is wrong — both are worth reading to the user before acting on it.

agent.description: Agent id from the registry. Adds the file paths that agent reads.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag. Presentation hint only: the catalog is English.
